## Description

Add opt-in training-batch capture and offline replay for single-controller SGLang RL with both AReaL v1 and v2. `trajectory_debug.mode` defaults to `off`; `dump` saves the batch consumed by training, and `replay` performs training updates without creating rollout, evaluation, proxy, or inference weight-transfer services.

`rollout` snapshots precede auxiliary scoring, while `full` snapshots retain its results before advantage computation. Versioned manifests and CPU tensors preserve logical groups and processed multimodal inputs. The same change restores training policy versions during recovery without inference and keeps replay lifecycle logging consistent with actual execution.

Usage and reproducible minimal/three-step GPU scripts are in `examples/trajectory_replay/`; the configuration and debugging guides are updated in English and Chinese.

## Related Issue

Reference: #1407. This is an implementation for the current trainer and controller APIs.

## Type of Change

- [ ] 🐛 Bug fix
- [x] ✨ New feature
- [ ] 💥 Breaking change
- [ ] 📝 Documentation update
- [ ] ♻️ Refactoring
- [ ] ⚡ Performance improvement
- [ ] ✅ Test coverage improvement

## Validation

- Real v1/v2 SGLang + Megatron + Awex RL baselines, text rollout capture/replay, and three-step Qwen3.5-9B multimodal full capture/replay.
- Reference scoring with both snapshot scopes on both versions; default-off initial/post-update held-out evaluation; actual checkpoint changes and finite training metrics.
- In the three-step 9B full replay comparisons, v1 checkpoints match exactly. v2 matches exactly for the first two steps; the third step has a maximum absolute delta of `1.9073486328125e-6`, with no elements outside the predefined tolerance.
- In the 0.6B fixed-input capture/replay comparisons, all 311 checkpoint tensors (751,632,384 elements) match exactly. v1 offline checkpoint/optimizer recovery also matches uninterrupted updates.
- Two matched off/dump runs per version measure snapshot time, file size, CPU/GPU peaks, and parameter tolerances. These are short functional/cost measurements, not an online-throughput improvement or a long-term stability claim.
- Full `pre-commit run --all-files` passes. Canonical `./docs/build_all.sh` succeeds for both languages with six existing warnings per language. Updated-main platform imports and CUDA selection are checked in the actual GPU container; historical GPU results retain their recorded source identities.
- Unit-test code is prepared; execution is pending the exact full feature head's CI. The agent has not run AReaL UT locally or remotely.

## Checklist

- [x] I have read the [Contributing Guide](https://github.com/areal-project/community/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md)
- [x] Pre-commit hooks pass (`pre-commit run --all-files`)
- [ ] Relevant tests pass; new tests added for new functionality
- [x] Documentation updated (built with `./docs/build_all.sh`; warnings disclosed above)
- [x] Branch is up to date with the reviewed `main` baseline
- [ ] Self-reviewed via `/review-pr` command
- [x] This PR was created by a coding agent via `/create-pr`
- [ ] This PR is a breaking change

Independent read-only Pre-CI review approved the complete change, and the controlled publication gate verified the final single commit against the reviewed candidate. Required CI for this exact feature head is still pending.

## Additional Context

The new debug mode is disabled by default. Training-only recovery now restores the training policy version, including existing SFT/DPO/reward-model recovery callers; the inference-backed recovery path is unchanged.

Replay is a debugging tool for saved batches. Snapshots do not include model, optimizer, or RNG state and do not make stale responses equivalent to fresh on-policy RL. Replay requires matching controller version, model, training topology, batch settings, and scope, and it reads only trusted snapshots using restricted deserialization.

Validated combinations are GRPO without critic/teacher and the reference-scoring paths above. Critic/teacher integration has no dedicated GPU acceptance; v2 native checkpoint recovery, other controller modes, online agents, and inference evaluation during replay remain unsupported. Snapshot IO and CPU memory have a cost; three-step results do not establish leak freedom or long-term training quality.

+"""Self-contained batch snapshots for single-controller RL debugging."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import json
+import os
+import tempfile
+from collections.abc import Callable
+from pathlib import Path
+from typing import Any, BinaryIO
+
+import torch
+
+from areal.infra.rpc.rtensor import RTensor, clear_fetch_buffer, flatten_shard_ids
+from areal.utils.data import RolloutGroup
+
+
+class TrajectoryStore:
+    """Own a versioned directory of complete, CPU-resident training batches.
+
+    A single controller writes one file per global step. Published files are
+    immutable; a failed/interrupted temporary file cannot appear as a valid step.
+    Only tensors and primitive containers are deserialized, never remote handles
+    or arbitrary Python classes. Callers must retain model/optimizer state
+    separately to reproduce a particular update.
+    """
+
+    FORMAT_VERSION = 1
+
+    def __init__(self, path: str, *, scope: str, identity: dict[str, Any]):
+        self.path = Path(path)
+        self.scope = scope
+        self.identity = identity
+
+    def initialize_dump(self, *, steps_per_epoch: int, batch_size: int) -> None:
+        self.path.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+        manifest = {
+            "format_version": self.FORMAT_VERSION,
+            "scope": self.scope,
+            "identity": self.identity,
+            "steps_per_epoch": steps_per_epoch,
+            "batch_size": batch_size,
+        }
+        self._publish("manifest.json", lambda f: f.write(json.dumps(manifest).encode()))
+
+    def replay_manifest(self, *, batch_size: int) -> dict[str, Any]:
+        with (self.path / "manifest.json").open() as f:
+            manifest = json.load(f)
+        expected = {
+            "format_version": self.FORMAT_VERSION,
+            "scope": self.scope,
+            "identity": self.identity,
+            "batch_size": batch_size,
+        }
+        for key, value in expected.items():
+            if manifest.get(key) != value:
+                raise ValueError(
+                    f"Trajectory manifest {key} does not match replay config"
+                )
+        if (
+            type(manifest.get("steps_per_epoch")) is not int
+            or manifest["steps_per_epoch"] < 1
+        ):
+            raise ValueError("Trajectory manifest needs positive steps_per_epoch")
+        return manifest
+
+    def validate_steps(self, start: int, stop: int) -> None:
+        for step in range(start, stop):
+            if not self._step_path(step).is_file():
+                raise FileNotFoundError(f"Missing trajectory snapshot for step {step}")
+
+    def save(self, batch: list[dict[str, Any]], step: int) -> Path:
+        # localize() mutates wrappers and fills the process-local fetch buffer.
+        # Work on a copied graph, retain aliases, and drain only this batch's
+        # cached shards even if fetching or encoding fails. Storage stays live
+        # until the trainer's normal clear_batches fan-out.
+        shard_ids = flatten_shard_ids(batch)
+        try:
+            copied = self._copy_wrappers(batch, {})
+            local = RTensor.localize(copied, preserve_tensor_aliases=True)
+            encoded = self._encode(copied, {})
+            self._validate_batch(local)
+            payload = {
+                "format_version": self.FORMAT_VERSION,
+                "scope": self.scope,
+                "step": step,
+                "batch": encoded,
+            }
+            self._publish(self._step_path(step).name, lambda f: torch.save(payload, f))
+        finally:
+            clear_fetch_buffer(shard_ids)
+        return self._step_path(step)
+
+    def load(self, step: int) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
+        payload = torch.load(
+            self._step_path(step), map_location="cpu", weights_only=True
+        )
+        if not isinstance(payload, dict) or any(
+            payload.get(key) != value
+            for key, value in (
+                ("format_version", self.FORMAT_VERSION),
+                ("scope", self.scope),
+                ("step", step),
+            )
+        ):
+            raise ValueError(f"Incompatible trajectory snapshot at step {step}")
+        batch = self._decode(payload["batch"], {})
+        self._validate_batch(batch)
+        return batch
+
+    def _step_path(self, step: int) -> Path:
+        return self.path / f"step_{step:06d}.pt"
+
+    def _publish(self, name: str, write: Callable[[BinaryIO], Any]) -> None:
+        # A hard link publishes the completed file atomically without replacing
+        # another run's snapshot. Both names live on the same filesystem.
+        with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(dir=self.path, delete=False) as f:
+            temporary = Path(f.name)
+            try:
+                write(f)
+                f.flush()
+                os.fsync(f.fileno())
+                os.link(temporary, self.path / name)
+            finally:
+                temporary.unlink(missing_ok=True)
+
+    @classmethod
+    def _copy_wrappers(cls, value: Any, memo: dict[int, Any]) -> Any:
+        if id(value) in memo:
+            return memo[id(value)]
+        if isinstance(value, RTensor):
+            copied = RTensor(shard=value.shard, data=value.data)
+        elif isinstance(value, dict):
+            copied = {k: cls._copy_wrappers(v, memo) for k, v in value.items()}
+        elif isinstance(value, (list, tuple)):
+            copied = type(value)(cls._copy_wrappers(v, memo) for v in value)
+        else:
+            return value
+        memo[id(value)] = copied
+        return copied
+
+    @classmethod
+    def _encode(cls, value: Any, memo: dict[int, Any]) -> Any:
+        if id(value) in memo:
+            return memo[id(value)]
+        if isinstance(value, RTensor):
+            encoded = cls._encode(value.data, memo)
+        elif isinstance(value, torch.Tensor):
+            if value.is_meta:
+                raise ValueError(
+                    "Trajectory snapshot contains an unresolved meta tensor"
+                )
+            encoded = value.detach().to(device="cpu", copy=True)
+        elif isinstance(value, RolloutGroup):
+            encoded = {
+                "__areal_rollout_group__": True,
+                "row_counts": value.row_counts,
+                "rewards": value.rewards,
+            }
+        elif isinstance(value, dict):
+            if "__areal_rollout_group__" in value:
+                raise ValueError("Reserved trajectory metadata key in batch")
+            encoded = {k: cls._encode(v, memo) for k, v in value.items()}
+        elif isinstance(value, (list, tuple)):
+            encoded = type(value)(cls._encode(v, memo) for v in value)
+        elif value is None or type(value) in (bool, int, float, str):
+            return value
+        else:
+            raise TypeError(
+                f"Unsupported trajectory snapshot value: {type(value).__name__}"
+            )
+        memo[id(value)] = encoded
+        return encoded
+
+    @classmethod
+    def _decode(cls, value: Any, memo: dict[int, Any]) -> Any:
+        if id(value) in memo:
+            return memo[id(value)]
+        if isinstance(value, dict):
+            if value.get("__areal_rollout_group__") is True:
+                decoded = RolloutGroup(value["row_counts"], value["rewards"])
+            else:
+                decoded = {k: cls._decode(v, memo) for k, v in value.items()}
+        elif isinstance(value, (list, tuple)):
+            decoded = type(value)(cls._decode(v, memo) for v in value)
+        else:
+            return value
+        memo[id(value)] = decoded
+        return decoded
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def _validate_batch(batch: Any) -> None:
+        if not isinstance(batch, list) or not batch:
+            raise ValueError("Trajectory snapshot must contain a nonempty batch list")
+        token_fields = (
+            "input_ids",
+            "attention_mask",
+            "loss_mask",
+            "logprobs",
+            "versions",
+        )
+        required = (*token_fields, "rewards")
+        for trajectory in batch:
+            if not isinstance(trajectory, dict) or any(
+                not isinstance(trajectory.get(key), torch.Tensor) for key in required
+            ):
+                raise ValueError(f"Trajectory snapshot needs tensor fields {required}")
+            shape = trajectory["input_ids"].shape
+            if len(shape) != 2 or any(
+                trajectory[key].shape != shape for key in token_fields
+            ):
+                raise ValueError(
+                    "Trajectory token fields must have matching [rows, tokens] shapes"
+                )
+            rewards = trajectory["rewards"]
+            if rewards.ndim < 1 or rewards.shape[0] != shape[0]:
+                raise ValueError("Trajectory rewards must match the token row count")
+            group = trajectory.get("rollout_group")
+            if group is not None:
+                if not isinstance(group, RolloutGroup):
+                    raise ValueError("Invalid rollout_group in trajectory snapshot")
+                group.validate_rows(trajectory["input_ids"].shape[0])

+
+For single-controller SGLang RL, `trajectory_debug.mode=dump` captures the actual
+training batch as CPU tensors. `trajectory_debug.mode=replay` reads those batches

+`full` to reuse scores captured immediately before advantage computation. Replay
+requires the same model, controller version, training topology, batch size and scope,
+and `valid_dataset=null`. Missing steps fail explicitly. A batch snapshot is separate
+from model/optimizer/RNG checkpoints and is intended for debugging with fixed data.

+# 训练批次保存与离线回放
+
+此例用于 single-controller SGLang RL 调试，支持 v1/v2 训练控制器。 single-controller 可以管理多个
+GPU。功能默认关闭，普通训练无需改配置。 本例及验收脚本尚未在本地执行；真实 GPU 验收状态见 RFC，不以脚本存在表示通过。
+
+在原有 RL 配置上，通过标准入口保存实际训练批次：
+
+```bash
+areal train run --config <baseline.yaml> \
+  --driver examples.trajectory_replay.train:main \
+  ++trajectory_debug.mode=dump \
+  ++trajectory_debug.path=<snapshot-directory> \
+  ++trajectory_debug.scope=rollout
+```
+
+`rollout` 保存收集后的批次，回放时重新计算辅助模型评分和 prox logp。 `full` 保存评分后、advantage 前的批次，回放时直接复用评分；仅评分的
+ref/teacher 不创建，需要更新的 critic 仍创建。每步写一个 CPU 张量文件和一个版本化 manifest。
+所有字段、嵌套多模态张量和逻辑分组均保留，不保存原服务引用。 `trajectory_debug.steps=[0,1,2]` 可以只保存指定步；空列表不保存任何步。
+现有同名文件不可覆盖，重试捕获应使用新目录。
+
+捕获运行退出、原推理和张量存储服务已关闭后，使用相同模型初始状态、控制器版本、 训练拓扑、batch size 和 scope 回放：
+
+```bash
+areal train run --config <baseline.yaml> \
+  --driver examples.trajectory_replay.train:main \
+  ++trajectory_debug.mode=replay \
+  ++trajectory_debug.path=<snapshot-directory> \
+  ++trajectory_debug.scope=rollout \
+  valid_dataset=null ++total_train_steps=3
+```
+
+回放不加载训练数据、不启动 rollout/eval/proxy、推理 teacher 或权重传输服务。 训练 worker、训练 RPC/gateway、PPO
+更新、LR、保存和统计继续使用原实现。 快照保留原始 global step；缺失文件会报错，不会循环最后一批。 要回放后续步，使用现有模型/优化器恢复机制对齐起点。
+快照本身不包含模型、优化器或 RNG 状态，不保证与重新在线采样等价。
+
+当前不支持其他控制器执行方式、MOPD、online agent、回放时推理评测， 或自动跨版本/拓扑转换。rollout-engine teacher 需要 `full`
+回放。 只读取可信的自己生成的快照，仍使用 `weights_only=True` 限制反序列化。
+
+实际 GPU 验证覆盖 v1/v2 的无 critic/teacher GRPO，以及 reference 评分的 rollout/full 路径。 上文
+critic/teacher 描述的是代码接入方式，这些组合尚未完成专项 GPU 验证，不能据此承诺这些组合可用。 v1 已验证模型/优化器恢复后的离线续训；v2
+原生控制器不支持 checkpoint 恢复，本功能不扩展该限制。 三步运行只证明所测短程链路，不证明长期稳定性或无内存泄漏。
+
+## GPU 复现脚本
+
+依赖已安装的 AReaL、SGLang、Megatron、Awex 及兼容 checkpoint/tokenizer； 不安装依赖、不创建
+allocation、不操作宿主。请在已授权的 allocation 容器中运行。 v1 默认 actor `megatron:d2`、rollout
+`sglang:d2`，两张 GPU 上同卡交替执行，以满足 v1 Awex CUDA IPC 的设备配对和 worker 数量要求。 v2 默认 actor
+`megatron:d1`、rollout `sglang:d1`，分离占用两张 GPU。 可通过参数增加资源；后端拓扑必须与 `--gpus` 和模型相符。
+临时目录须位于授权根目录下；用户已授权容器 `/tmp` 时，也可使用独立的 `/tmp/rsi-<task>` 子目录仅承载 IPC 及必要运行临时文件。路径要足够短，并支持
+UNIX socket。 脚本预检失败时不启动训练，不自动改用其他目录。
+
+以 GSM8K 和一个较小的 Qwen3 checkpoint 为最小配置；所有路径由操作员填写：
+
+```bash
+bash examples/trajectory_replay/minimal.sh \
+  --config examples/math/gsm8k_grpo_awex_colocate.yaml \
+  --model <read-only-model> --data <read-only-gsm8k> \
+  --write-root <authorized-root> --output <new-capture-output> \
+  --temp <short-authorized-temp> --version v1 --mode dump --scope rollout
+
+bash examples/trajectory_replay/minimal.sh \
+  --config examples/math/gsm8k_grpo_awex_colocate.yaml \
+  --model <same-model> --data <same-data> \
+  --write-root <authorized-root> --output <new-replay-output> \
+  --temp <short-authorized-temp> --version v1 --mode replay --scope rollout \
+  --snapshots <new-capture-output>/snapshots
+```
+
+将 `--version` 改为 `v2`，使用新的输出和捕获目录重复；两版分别捕获、分别回放。 每版对 `--scope full` 再执行一组。`minimal.sh`
+固定一步真实更新； `end_to_end.sh` 使用相同参数，固定三步。端到端优先更大的兼容模型， Geometry3K 可使用其现有 Megatron
+配置并传入对应模型、数据及必要 override：
+
+```text
+--config examples/vlm/qwen3_5_2b_megatron_geometry3k_grpo.yaml
+--override ++sglang.enable_multimodal=true
+--override ++gconfig.max_tokens=2048 --override ++sglang.context_length=2048
+```
+
+已验证的 Qwen3.5-9B 三步 full 配置使用 v1 的默认 `d2/d2` 同卡执行；v2 使用
+`--actor-backend megatron:d2 --rollout-backend sglang:d1 --gpus 3` 分离执行，并设置
+`--override ++rollout.max_head_offpolicyness=0`。这些结果不构成其他拓扑或模型的兼容承诺。 `--override`
+可以重复，最后应用；不应在参数中传凭据或覆盖获准写入/资源边界。 脚本将模型、输出、缓存和 name-resolve 等配置通过 overrides 传给
+`areal train run --config ... --driver ...`，保留基线 YAML。 driver 用标准 loader 保存脱敏后的最终有效配置。 加
+`--prepare-only` 可只通过标准 loader 解析、校验并保存配置，不创建 worker； 这是配置准备，不能代替 GPU 验收。它也会占用一个新输出目录。
+v2 示例每次生成临时唯一 admin key，以环境变量引用传给训练和推理服务；命令记录不包含密钥，标准配置保存会脱敏。
+
+为避免小模型的全错答案经组归一化变为零优势，脚本关闭 reward/advantage 归一化并设置 reward bias 为 -0.5；仍调用原真实奖励与 PPO 计算。
+短程脚本还显式关闭学习率 warmup，避免基于完整 dataloader 长度的 warmup 令首步学习率为零。 所有 baseline/capture/replay
+对照使用相同设置，不用此短程配置声称质量提升。 直接使用 driver 时不会自动改变这些算法配置。
+
+每次输出包含 `command.json`、`source.json`、`process.json`、`console.log`、
+`result.json`，以及训练器日志、有效配置和每步 HF checkpoint。 输出目录须为新目录；保存快照目录也不能与其他捕获复用。 单次默认超时 1800
+秒，可用 `--timeout` 调整。超时/中断仅终止本脚本创建的训练进程组； 不取消 allocation，不清理其他服务或旧产物。不要同时运行共享同一 GPU 的用例。
+
+## 如何判定验收
+
+退出码非零、缺失步文件/参数更新/关键服务日志、非有限 loss/gradient、 退化全 mask 或未观察到实际版本路径均为失败或未完成。退出零也需检查：
+
+1. v1/v2 日志分别显示真实控制器/worker；capture 有 SGLang rollout、Megatron 更新、Awex 传输及后续
+   rollout，未使用磁盘 fallback 冒充 Awex。
+1. 原 capture 所属服务已销毁，replay 未创建推理、proxy、权重交换服务，也没有请求旧端点。
+1. 快照值、dtype、shape、逻辑分组和多模态字段完整，loss/gradient 有限且有有效训练信号； 对比初始权重与保存的 HF
+   checkpoint，确认实际参数变化，不能只数日志步骤。
+1. 相同初始状态和固定批次下对比首步 loss/gradient/参数样本， BF16 初始 `rtol=1e-3, atol=1e-4`，记录最大差异及非确定性限制。
+1. 每版运行相同工作量的 `--mode off` 与 dump，至少两组，区分预热， 记录保存耗时、step time、文件字节与 CPU/GPU 峰值。
+   回放省去在线生成的耗时不代表在线 RL 吞吐提升。
+
+完整标准在中文 [RFC](RFC.md)。准备的 UT 交给用户或 CI 执行：
+
+```bash
+pytest tests/test_trajectory_replay.py tests/test_recover.py tests/test_trainer_eval_before_train.py
+```
+
+本地不执行 UT，CI 专属检查保留为 PENDING_CI。真实 v1/v2、main 基线、工程检查完成后， 按任务规范由受控独立只读 Reviewer 检查完整候选，保存
+Pre-CI review PASS 和 `ci_allowed=true`。每轮 verify
+前先读取适用经验并记录实际采用，结果后自动进行独立只读复盘；再通过同时核对复盘回执的发布 gate 及 squash 后的实际 head 内容校验，才执行可能触发 CI
+的推送、创建 PR、打标或重跑。 FAIL/INCOMPLETE 返回修复或补证，候选变化先验证并以新独立上下文重新 review。 PR 后最新 head 的必需 CI
+全过才算交付，不自动合并。

+## 1. 功能与收益

+现有可读轨迹日志能帮助查看对话，但不足以恢复实际训练输入。开发者若要复现一次 PPO 更新，通常仍需重新生成 rollout 并保持推理服务。

+
+预期收益是新增离线调试能力、减少调试对推理资源和服务存活的依赖。保存会增加磁盘、CPU 内存与 IO 时间。 回放陈旧响应用于调试，不宣称与新的 on-policy RL

+"""Single-controller text/vision RL capture and inference-free replay driver."""

+import sys
+
+import areal
+from areal import PPOTrainer

+from areal.utils.hf_utils import load_hf_processor_and_tokenizer

+def main(args: list[str]) -> None:
+    # The standard loader saves the resolved, redacted effective configuration.
+    config, _ = load_expr_config(args, GRPOConfig)
+    getLogger("RLTrainer").info("Trajectory example uses AReaL at %s", areal.__file__)
+    if config.trajectory_debug.mode == "replay":
+        with PPOTrainer(config) as trainer:
+            trainer.train()
+        return
+
+    processor, tokenizer = load_hf_processor_and_tokenizer(config.tokenizer_path)
+    train_dataset = get_custom_dataset(
+        split="train",
+        dataset_config=config.train_dataset,
+        tokenizer=tokenizer,
+        processor=processor,
+    )
+    valid_dataset = None
+    if config.valid_dataset is not None:
+        valid_dataset = get_custom_dataset(
+            split="test",
+            dataset_config=config.valid_dataset,
+            tokenizer=tokenizer,
+            processor=processor,
+        )
+    vision = "geometry3k" in config.train_dataset.path
+    if config.rollout._version == "v2":
+        # The v2 gateway accepts agents with run(), not RolloutWorkflow classes.
+        workflow = (
+            "areal.workflow.openai.geometry3k_agent.Geometry3KAgent"
+            if vision
+            else "areal.workflow.openai.math_agent.MathAgent"
+        )
+        kwargs = dict(
+            temperature=config.gconfig.temperature,
+            top_p=config.gconfig.top_p,
+            max_tokens=config.gconfig.max_tokens,
+            max_completion_tokens=config.gconfig.max_new_tokens,
+        )
+        eval_kwargs = {**kwargs, "temperature": 0.6}
+    else:
+        kwargs = dict(
+            gconfig=config.gconfig,
+            tokenizer=config.tokenizer_path,
+            enable_thinking=False,
+        )
+        if vision:
+            workflow = "areal.workflow.vision_rlvr.VisionRLVRWorkflow"
+            kwargs.update(
+                processor=config.tokenizer_path,
+                reward_fn="examples.vlm.geometry3k_grpo.geometry3k_reward_fn",
+            )
+        else:
+            workflow = "areal.workflow.rlvr.RLVRWorkflow"
+            kwargs["reward_fn"] = "areal.reward.gsm8k.gsm8k_reward_fn"
+        eval_kwargs = {**kwargs, "gconfig": config.gconfig.new(temperature=0.6)}
+
+    with PPOTrainer(config, train_dataset, valid_dataset) as trainer:
+        trainer.train(
+            workflow=workflow,
+            workflow_kwargs=kwargs,
+            eval_workflow=workflow,
+            eval_workflow_kwargs=eval_kwargs,
+        )
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main(sys.argv[1:])
